Interactive UI overhaul — one language

Every interactive control mapped to a single primitive set on the Radix teal + slate tokens. Theme-adaptive throughout. This is the target state; flip the theme to verify both modes.

token: --dm-accent-9

Today the docs run three accents at once. The overhaul routes everything through one teal token.
